text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "PostHistoryTypeId is a low-cardinality event-type enumeration (25 distinct codes, values 1–38) for post revision history, while badges.Id is a surrogate primary key for badge-award rows (1–92240), so the 0.92 containment is just small integers coincidentally falling inside a dense integer key range, with no semantic reference between history event types and badge awards."}
